altdorfer_alexander_issus_wow_v54.story: An impossible battle: cosmic sky and a whole imagined world conceal thousands of tiny human fighters; the title plaque and red cord bring the distant history into focus. Begin with the entire world, uncover the micro-battle, end with the complete image.

scenes.intent: Open with the stormy cosmic sky and the vast battle in a single authentic painting, with exact title and artist in the approved band.
The radiant horizon and sweeping clouds make the painted battle feel like an entire world.
The thin crescent moon in the left upper sky counters the warm light at the opposite horizon.
The glowing sun and distant coastline establish a nearly cosmic scale before returning to human conflict.
Mountains, rivers, settlements and armies compress an imagined geography into one view.
Thousands of tiny figures and colored banners become legible as a mass of individual human lives.
The red and blue battle standards draw attention to the two opposing forces without invented motion.
The densely packed cavalry makes the contrast between human scale and cosmic landscape unmistakable.
The Latin inscription panel suspended over the sky introduces the painting as a deliberate historical narrative.
Return to the confrontation beneath the extraordinary geography; one restrained movement, no fake animation.
Hold the horizon and mountainous world after the soldiers have been seen close up, changing the emotional reading.
Reveal the complete authentic panel against a neutral solid backdrop, preserving all edges and avoiding a second blurred copy.
